bio_am: Ծնած է մօտաւորապէս 1885-ին՝ Փեթար գիւղը։ 1904-էն Գէորգ Չաւուշի անբաժան ընկերը եղաւ եւ ինկաւ Կողբի մէջ՝ 1920 Սեպտեմբեր 4-ին։
bio_en: Manuk was born around 1885 in the village of Petar in Taron and studied at the monastery of St. Hovhannes. In 1903-04 he served as a secret courier between St. Karapet, Petar and Sasun, and in the 1904 Sasun uprising he went to the mountains with four other young men of his village. From autumn 1904 he led his own band alongside Gevorg Chavush and later worked with Ruben Ter-Minasian in Taron. In 1918 he led a cavalry unit at the battle of Bash-Abaran with Dro's forces, and he was killed leading a charge at Koghb on 4 September 1920.
